name: Pan-Seared Steak with Sautéed Brussels Sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Wash sprouts, trim rough ends and halve lengthwise. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb ribeye steak
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Place steak in skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil; set aside.
Peel and thinly slice shallots. Peel and mince garlic.
Once steak has been transferred, melt oil in skillet. Add brussels sprouts, shallots, and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sprouts are browned, 4-5 minutes.
Add 1 cup water to sprouts and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sprouts are tender and liquid has evaporated, 4-5 minutes.
Drizzle with vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, for another 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tbsp balsamic vinegar
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve steak with brussels sprouts on a plate. Enjoy!
